---
title: "Examples"
---

Multi-layer, map-backed visualizations using real public datasets. Each example downloads live data, builds layers, and renders an interactive deck.gl map.

Click any example to view the full visualization and source code.

| Example | Layers | Description |
|---------|--------|-------------|
| [Global Flight Routes](examples/global-flight-routes.qmd){target="_blank"} | ArcLayer, ScatterplotLayer, TextLayer | Airline routes between the world's 40 busiest airports from the OpenFlights database, rendered as great-circle arcs with labeled airport markers on a dark basemap. |
| [Tokyo Region Earthquakes](examples/tokyo-earthquakes.qmd){target="_blank"} | HexagonLayer | USGS seismic data (2020--2024, M1.5+) near Tokyo aggregated into extruded 3D hexagonal bins colored by density. |
| [London Buildings 3D](examples/london-buildings-3d.qmd){target="_blank"} | PolygonLayer | Real building footprints with heights from OpenStreetMap in the City of London financial district, extruded to actual height and colored by elevation. |
| [Paris Trees](examples/paris-trees.qmd){target="_blank"} | HeatmapLayer, ScatterplotLayer | 5,000 trees managed by the City of Paris shown as a height-weighted heatmap overlaid with individual tree points. |
| [UK Road Accidents](examples/uk-road-accidents.qmd){target="_blank"} | GridLayer | ~140,000 personal injury road accidents aggregated into an extruded 3D grid over central London. |
| [Australia / Indo-Pacific Earthquakes](examples/australia-earthquakes.qmd){target="_blank"} | ScatterplotLayer, HexagonLayer, ArcLayer | 2024 M4.5+ earthquakes across the Indo-Pacific with magnitude-colored scatter points, hexagonal density bins, and monitoring station arcs. |
| [US Fire Hotspots](examples/us-fire-hotspots.qmd){target="_blank"} | HeatmapLayer, ScatterplotLayer, TextLayer | Near real-time satellite fire detections (NASA FIRMS, VIIRS NOAA-20, 7-day window) as a fire-radiative-power-weighted heatmap with city reference labels. |
